title: Jubilant Sweet Brazilian Coconut Pudding
description: A sweet and pillowy Brazilian dessert featuring coconut and a hint of spice, served in an agave leaf vessel. This dish is free from animal products, making it Buddhist-temple-friendly.
instructions: Combine the coconut milk, sugar, cornstarch, and salt in a medium saucepan and whisk until smooth.
Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until the mixture comes to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 5 minutes, or until the pudding has thickened.
Stir in the chopped capers, coconut oil, tadka spice blend, and vanilla extract.
Remove the pudding from the heat and let it cool to room temperature.
Cover the pudding and refrigerate it for at least 2 hours, or until chilled.
Spoon the pudding into agave leaves and serve chilled.
Garnish with additional chopped capers, if desired.
